title: Maepole — Southard Exchange
size: Standalone fast-casual restaurant with drive-thru pickup lane; part of 16.94-acre Southard Exchange
timing: Forsyth News photographed the restaurant under construction on September 3, 2026. The Cumming location is Maepole's first standalone drive-thru format, so remaining MEP, kitchen, controls, low-voltage, finishes, commissioning and punch-list work are near-term follow-up targets.
source: Forsyth News + Abernathy Development Southard Exchange project page

title: Chick-fil-A — Southard Exchange
size: Freestanding drive-thru restaurant outparcel on approximately 1.94 acres
timing: Public commercial-property marketing updated in early September projects a September 2026 grand opening. The project is late-stage, making equipment, controls, commissioning, site completion and punch-list/vendor follow-up the most realistic remaining opportunity.
source: Georgia economic-development property feed / Southard Exchange commercial listing

title: East Ridge at Settingdown — Commercial Development
size: Approximately 31 acres / just under 200,000 SF commercial; Vertical Earth HQ + RaceTrac + two restaurant spaces + four additional commercial buildings
developer: East Ridge at Settingdown development team / Vertical Earth anchor
timing: Project is under construction at GA-400 and Settingdown Road with building deliveries expected through 2026. Unnamed restaurant and commercial buildings create a continuing tenant-procurement and TI pipeline even as the Vertical Earth headquarters advances.
source: Forsyth zoning record + current North Forsyth commercial-development reporting

title: Cumming City Park Retaining Wall Improvements
size: $2M reported value; replace ~350 LF existing tie-back wall with ~390 LF Versalok wall plus drainage/site work
timing: Bid closed August 11, 2026; ConstructConnect lists an October 12, 2026 start. Next move is award/prime-contractor identification and subcontract/material outreach for demolition, wall system, drainage, grading and site restoration. Public design-question contact in the bid record: Alex Niebieski, Kimley-Horn.
source: City of Cumming procurement listing + ConstructConnect

title: Cumming PWPF Generator and Switchgear Project
size: Potable Water Production Facility generator/switchgear program including multiple generators, transformers, controls, new electrical building, yard piping and 6-MG clearwell work
timing: Proposal deadline passed August 7, 2026. The City still lists the project on its current procurement page, so monitor award/notice-to-proceed and target the selected prime for generator, switchgear, transformer, controls, electrical-building and commissioning packages.
source: City of Cumming current bid page + Georgia Procurement Registry mirror

title: Wills Park Lighting & Light Pole Replacement
size: Eight baseball fields; LED fixture upgrades and steel pole replacement
timing: Bid deadline passed September 3, 2026. Monitor City award/notice-to-proceed and contact the selected prime for lighting equipment, poles, concrete, controls and restoration packages. City purchasing contact: purchasing@alpharetta.ga.us.

title: Roswell Water Storage Tank Maintenance Program
size: 10-year full-service maintenance program covering two municipal water storage tanks
timing: Still open; proposals are due September 10, 2026 at 2:00 PM ET. Public procurement contact: Julie Barnwell, Deputy Director for Strategic Procurement, 770-594-6197.

title: Western Corridor Sanitary Sewer Improvements
size: ~4,360 LF sewer + duplex pump station + electrical/control infrastructure
timing: Still open; bids are due September 17, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET. The mandatory pre-bid meeting was August 20, so prime-bid eligibility is limited to attendees; subcontractors and suppliers should target known plan holders/primes.

title: Heritage Park Design-Build
size: Turnkey downtown passive park design-build; marketplace estimate $5M-$15M
timing: SOQ remains due September 17, 2026. Strong opportunity for design-build teams and downstream civil, utility, landscape, lighting and hardscape partners. City purchasing contact: purchasing@alpharetta.ga.us.
source: City of Alpharetta procurement / vendor system
